name: Jérez del Marquesado (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jérez del Marquesado (a tower, a saltire and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Jérez del Marquesado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Jérez del Marquesado arms — tower, saltire and tree
